cases.canonicalQuestion: When can a Trooper use Alert?
cases.draftAnswer: A Trooper may use Alert if it was not activated by an Order or ARO during that Order and either it or an allied Trooper in its Zone of Control was targeted by an Attack.

cases.canonicalQuestion: What does Alert let an eligible Trooper do?
cases.draftAnswer: At the Conclusion of the Order, after Saving Rolls, an eligible Trooper may turn on the spot to change its LoF angle. This is automatic, requires no Roll, does not change position, and generates no ARO.

cases.canonicalQuestion: After failing to Discover a Marker, when may that same Trooper try again against it?
cases.draftAnswer: That Trooper cannot attempt to Discover the same Marker again until the next Player Turn. It may still Discover a different Marker, and a different friendly Trooper may attempt to Discover the original Marker.

cases.canonicalQuestion: What happens if a declared Skill fails its Requirements at Resolution?

cases.canonicalQuestion: What does Look Out allow friendly Troopers to do?
cases.draftAnswer: Look Out allows the declaring player's other Troopers to modify their LoF without moving. Each modification counts as that Trooper's ARO and is resolved with a Normal or Face to Face Dodge (PH-3) Roll as applicable.
